filmInfo.title: Avengers: Doomsday
filmInfo.disclosureBanner: Recommendations are editorial judgments based on confirmed cast, released content, and storyline connections. Plot details for Doomsday have not been officially revealed. Speculation is clearly labeled.

unconfirmedCast.note: Reported but not officially confirmed as of last verification

recommendations.reason: Establishes Avengers team dynamics and the Infinity Saga's stakes. Essential for understanding what the Avengers are fighting to protect.
The aftermath of the Infinity Saga reshapes the entire roster. Doomsday directly builds on who survived and who was lost here.
Introduces the TVA and multiverse mechanics critical for understanding why characters from different universes can coexist in Doomsday.
Directly continues the multiverse setup. Loki's sacrifice restructures the timeline branches that Doomsday likely exploits.
Establishes multiverse mechanics, Incursions, and introduces the concept of alternate Earth variants — all directly relevant to Doctor Doom.
Leads directly into the Avengers team formation for Doomsday. Sam Wilson's arc as Captain America is central.
Team introduced here likely folds into the Doomsday roster. Confirmed to connect directly.
Introduces Professor X and Magneto — both confirmed in Doomsday's cast. Essential character grounding for their relationship.
Deepens X-Men relationships, particularly between Professor X, Magneto, and Nightcrawler. All three are confirmed in Doomsday.
Most important X-Men film for multiversal context. Involves timeline manipulation that foreshadows Doomsday's multiverse premise.
Final Fox Wolverine arc. Provides emotional closure for that version of the character relevant after Deadpool & Wolverine.
Directly bridges the Fox X-Men universe to the MCU. Confirms how these characters can appear alongside MCU Avengers in Doomsday.
Introduces Wakanda and Vibranium — both relevant to Avengers operations. Character context for Shuri.
Shuri's arc as Black Panther and Vibranium's role in the post-Endgame world.
Sam Wilson takes on the Captain America mantle. Provides character context for his role in Brave New World and Doomsday.
Nick Fury's arc and the geopolitical landscape relevant to Doomsday's setup.
Animated. Shows multiverse variants of major heroes. Helpful for understanding the broader multiverse concept Doomsday uses.
Establishes Doctor Strange as Sorcerer Supreme and introduces the mystic arts framework underlying multiverse mechanics.
